description: Land Title Settlement Department - Wallakelitiya, Opanayaka  D/S Division, Rathnapura District - Cad. Map No.620676 (24/120020)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, specifically calling for claims to land parcels in various blocks of Opanayaka village in Rathnapura District. It involves the Registration of Title Act and procedures for determining land ownership, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
